$comment: Remudero worker policy TEMPLATE. Rendered at runtime by renderWorkerSettings(): ${HOOKS_DIR} is replaced with the absolute hooks dir (kept out of the committed tree). Passed to workers ONLY — never merged into ~/.claude/settings.json. Sandbox keys match the INSTALLED schema (SDK 0.3.209 / CLI 2.1.209): allowedDomains nests under `network`, denyRead under `filesystem`. W1-T2211: `~/../state/service-tokens.json` denies the console's write-token file by the SAME path serviceTokensPath(config.root) resolves — the worker's redirected HOME is config.root/worker-home (config.js workerHomeDir), so `~/..` reaches config.root and `state/service-tokens.json` is its sibling. Deliberately the ONE file, never `state/**` — workers legitimately read the rest of the state tree.
